```{r echo=FALSE}
## Define  interaction table functions {-}

compact_emm_table <- function(emm_object,
                              by_var,
                              condition_prefix = NULL,
                              digits_est = 2,
                              digits_df = 1,
                              digits_p = 3) {
  
  by_var_name <- rlang::as_name(rlang::ensym(by_var))
  
  emm_df <- summary(emm_object) |> as.data.frame()
  contrast_df <- pairs(emm_object) |> summary() |> as.data.frame()
  
  # Exclude BOTH Satterthwaite/KR-style and asymptotic-style CI/df column names
  non_focal_cols <- c(by_var_name, "emmean", "SE", "df",
                      "lower.CL", "upper.CL",
                      "asymp.LCL", "asymp.UCL")
  
  focal_vars <- setdiff(names(emm_df), non_focal_cols)
  
  # Detect whichever CI column names are actually present
  lcl_col <- intersect(c("lower.CL", "asymp.LCL"), names(emm_df))
  ucl_col <- intersect(c("upper.CL", "asymp.UCL"), names(emm_df))
  
  emm_part <- emm_df |>
    rowwise() |>
    mutate(
      Comparison = paste(c_across(all_of(focal_vars)), collapse = " "),
      Condition = if (is.null(condition_prefix)) {
        as.character(.data[[by_var_name]])
      } else {
        paste(condition_prefix, "=", .data[[by_var_name]])
      }
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    transmute(
      Comparison,
      Condition,
      Estimate = emmean,
      SE,
      df,
      lower.CL = if (length(lcl_col) > 0) .data[[lcl_col]] else NA_real_,
      upper.CL = if (length(ucl_col) > 0) .data[[ucl_col]] else NA_real_,
      t.ratio = NA_real_,
      p.value = NA_real_
    )
  
  # Detect whichever test-statistic column name is present (t.ratio vs z.ratio)
  ratio_col <- intersect(c("t.ratio", "z.ratio"), names(contrast_df))
  
  contrast_part <- contrast_df |>
    mutate(
      Comparison = contrast,
      Condition = if (is.null(condition_prefix)) {
        as.character(.data[[by_var_name]])
      } else {
        paste(condition_prefix, "=", .data[[by_var_name]])
      }
    ) |>
    transmute(
      Comparison,
      Condition,
      Estimate = estimate,
      SE,
      df,
      lower.CL = NA_real_,
      upper.CL = NA_real_,
      t.ratio = if (length(ratio_col) > 0) .data[[ratio_col]] else NA_real_,
      p.value
    )
  
  bind_rows(emm_part, contrast_part) |>
    arrange(Condition, Comparison) |>
    mutate(
      Estimate = round(Estimate, digits_est),
      SE       = round(SE, digits_est),
      df       = round(df, digits_df),
      lower.CL = round(lower.CL, digits_est),
      upper.CL = round(upper.CL, digits_est),
      t.ratio  = round(t.ratio, digits_est),
      p.value  = round(p.value, digits_p)
    )
}

compact_3way_table <- function(emm_object,
                               by_var,
                               condition_prefix = NULL,
                               factor1,
                               factor2,
                               digits_est = 2,
                               digits_df = 1,
                               digits_p = 3) {
  
  by_var_name <- rlang::as_name(rlang::ensym(by_var))
  factor1_name <- rlang::as_name(rlang::ensym(factor1))
  factor2_name <- rlang::as_name(rlang::ensym(factor2))
  
  emm_df <- summary(emm_object) |>
    as.data.frame()
  
  make_condition <- function(x) {
    if (is.null(condition_prefix)) {
      as.character(x[[by_var_name]])
    } else {
      paste(condition_prefix, "=", x[[by_var_name]])
    }
  }
  
  emm_part <- emm_df |>
    mutate(
      Comparison = paste(.data[[factor1_name]], .data[[factor2_name]]),
      Condition = make_condition(cur_data())
    ) |>
    transmute(
      Comparison,
      Condition,
      Estimate = emmean,
      SE,
      df,
      lower.CL,
      upper.CL,
      t.ratio = NA_real_,
      p.value = NA_real_
    )
  
  factor1_part <- pairs(emm_object, simple = factor1_name) |>
    summary() |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    mutate(
      Comparison = contrast,
      Condition = paste(
        if (is.null(condition_prefix)) .data[[by_var_name]] else paste(condition_prefix, "=", .data[[by_var_name]]),
        "|",
        factor2_name, "=",
        .data[[factor2_name]]
      )
    ) |>
    transmute(
      Comparison,
      Condition,
      Estimate = estimate,
      SE,
      df,
      lower.CL = NA_real_,
      upper.CL = NA_real_,
      t.ratio,
      p.value
    )
  
  factor2_part <- pairs(emm_object, simple = factor2_name) |>
    summary() |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    mutate(
      Comparison = contrast,
      Condition = paste(
        if (is.null(condition_prefix)) .data[[by_var_name]] else paste(condition_prefix, "=", .data[[by_var_name]]),
        "|",
        factor1_name, "=",
        .data[[factor1_name]]
      )
    ) |>
    transmute(
      Comparison,
      Condition,
      Estimate = estimate,
      SE,
      df,
      lower.CL = NA_real_,
      upper.CL = NA_real_,
      t.ratio,
      p.value
    )
  
  interaction_part <- contrast(
    emm_object,
    interaction = c("pairwise", "pairwise")
  ) |>
    summary() |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    mutate(
      Comparison = paste0(
        "Int: ",
        .data[[paste0(factor1_name, "_pairwise")]],
        " across ",
        .data[[paste0(factor2_name, "_pairwise")]]
      ),
      Condition = make_condition(cur_data())
    ) |>
    transmute(
      Comparison,
      Condition,
      Estimate = estimate,
      SE,
      df,
      lower.CL = NA_real_,
      upper.CL = NA_real_,
      t.ratio,
      p.value
    )
  
  bind_rows(
    emm_part         |> mutate(RowType = 1),
    factor1_part     |> mutate(RowType = 2),
    factor2_part     |> mutate(RowType = 2),
    interaction_part |> mutate(RowType = 3)
  ) |>
    arrange(Condition, RowType, Comparison) |>
    mutate(
      Estimate = round(Estimate, digits_est),
      SE       = round(SE, digits_est),
      df       = round(df, digits_df),
      lower.CL = round(lower.CL, digits_est),
      upper.CL = round(upper.CL, digits_est),
      t.ratio  = round(t.ratio, digits_est),
      p.value  = round(p.value, digits_p)
    ) |>
    select(-RowType)
}



compact_3way_trends_table <- function(model,
                                      focal_var,
                                      moderator_var,
                                      condition_var,
                                      moderator_values,
                                      condition_prefix = NULL,
                                      digits_est = 2,
                                      digits_df = 1,
                                      digits_p = 3,
                                      lmerTest.limit = NULL) {
  
  library(emmeans)
  library(dplyr)
  library(rlang)
  
  focal_name     <- rlang::as_name(rlang::ensym(focal_var))
  moderator_name <- rlang::as_name(rlang::ensym(moderator_var))
  condition_name <- rlang::as_name(rlang::ensym(condition_var))
  
  # Construct emtrends formula:
  # ~ condition_var | moderator_var
  trend_formula <- as.formula(
    paste0("~ ", condition_name, " | ", moderator_name)
  )
  
  # Values at which the moderator is evaluated
  at_list <- setNames(
    list(moderator_values),
    moderator_name
  )
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Estimate focal-variable slopes at each moderator value
  # separately for each categorical condition
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  
  if (is.null(lmerTest.limit)) {
    
    trends <- emtrends(
      model,
      specs = trend_formula,
      var = focal_name,
      at = at_list
    )
    
  } else {
    
    trends <- emtrends(
      model,
      specs = trend_formula,
      var = focal_name,
      at = at_list,
      lmerTest.limit = lmerTest.limit
    )
  }
  
  trend_col <- paste0(focal_name, ".trend")
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Simple slopes
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  
  slope_part <- summary(
    trends,
    infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
  ) |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    mutate(
      Comparison = paste0(
        focal_name,
        " slope: ",
        .data[[condition_name]]
      ),
      
      Condition = paste0(
        moderator_name,
        " = ",
        .data[[moderator_name]]
      ),
      
      Estimate = .data[[trend_col]],
      
      RowType = 1
    ) |>
    transmute(
      Comparison,
      Condition,
      ModeratorValue = .data[[moderator_name]],
      Estimate,
      SE,
      df,
      lower.CL,
      upper.CL,
      t.ratio,
      p.value,
      RowType
    )
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Difference between focal-variable slopes across levels
  # of the categorical factor
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  
  contrast_part <- pairs(trends) |>
    summary(
      infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
    ) |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    mutate(
      Comparison = paste0(
        focal_name,
        " slope difference: ",
        contrast
      ),
      
      Condition = paste0(
        moderator_name,
        " = ",
        .data[[moderator_name]]
      ),
      
      RowType = 2
    ) |>
    transmute(
      Comparison,
      Condition,
      ModeratorValue = .data[[moderator_name]],
      Estimate = estimate,
      SE,
      df,
      lower.CL,
      upper.CL,
      t.ratio,
      p.value,
      RowType
    )
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Combine and format
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  
  bind_rows(
    slope_part,
    contrast_part
  ) |>
    arrange(
      .data$ModeratorValue,
      .data$RowType,
      .data$Comparison
    ) |>
    mutate(
      Estimate = round(Estimate, digits_est),
      SE       = round(SE, digits_est),
      df       = round(df, digits_df),
      lower.CL = round(lower.CL, digits_est),
      upper.CL = round(upper.CL, digits_est),
      t.ratio  = round(t.ratio, digits_est),
      p.value  = round(p.value, digits_p)
    ) |>
    select(-RowType, -ModeratorValue)
}


```

# Load Files

```{r load_files, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load data: erp_fs nonwords
erp_fs_nw <- read_csv("erp_fs_dmg.csv") |>
  filter(time_window == "N250" & lexical_status == "nonword") |>
  mutate(
    SubjID = factor(SubjID),
    chlabel = factor(chlabel),
    family_size = factor(family_size, 
                         levels = c("small", "large")),
    complexity = factor(complexity,
                    labels = c("simple", "complex")),
    time_window = factor(time_window),
    OS = as.numeric(Dim.2),
    LP = as.numeric(Dim.1)
  )


# Load data: erp_bf nonwords
erp_bf_nw <- read_csv("erp_bf_dmg.csv") |>
  filter(time_window == "N250" & lexical_status == "nonword") |>
  mutate(
    SubjID = factor(SubjID),
    chlabel = factor(chlabel),
    base_frequency = factor(base_frequency, 
                            levels = c("low", "high")),
    complexity = factor(complexity,
                    labels = c("simple", "complex")),
    time_window = factor(time_window),
    OS = as.numeric(Dim.2),
    LP = as.numeric(Dim.1)
  )

range(erp_fs_nw$OS, na.rm = TRUE)
range(erp_fs_nw$LP, na.rm = TRUE)
```



## N250 NONWORD DATA: 

### Model FAMILY SIZE

```{r anova_n250_nonwords_fs_comparisons}
contrasts(erp_fs_nw$complexity)  <- c(-0.5, 0.5)
contrasts(erp_fs_nw$family_size) <- c(-0.5, 0.5)

# Base model: current confirmed N250 structure, family_size now fully crossed rather than covariate-only
m_base_nw_n250 <- lmer(
  value ~ complexity * OS + complexity * LP + complexity * family_size +
    (1 | SubjID) + (1 | SubjID:chlabel),
  data = subset(erp_fs_nw, time_window == "N250"),
  REML = FALSE,
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
)

# Add all remaining two-way and three-way terms needed to reach the full four-way
m_full_nw_n250 <- lmer(
  value ~ complexity * OS * LP * family_size +
    (1 | SubjID) + (1 | SubjID:chlabel),
  data = subset(erp_fs_nw, time_window == "N250"),
  REML = FALSE,
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
)

anova(m_base_nw_n250, m_full_nw_n250)
summary(m_full_nw_n250)
```

```{r}
m_3way <- lmer(value ~ complexity*OS + complexity*LP + complexity*family_size +
                        OS*LP*family_size + complexity:OS:LP +
                        complexity:OS:family_size + complexity:LP:family_size +
                        (1|SubjID) + (1|SubjID:chlabel),
                data = subset(erp_fs_nw, time_window == "N250"),
                REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))

m_4way <- update(m_3way, . ~ . + complexity:OS:LP:family_size)

anova(m_3way, m_4way)
```

#### CONFIRMATORY MODEL

```{r}
m_confirm_nw_n250_fs <- lmer(
  value ~ complexity * OS * LP * family_size +
    (1 | SubjID) + (1 | SubjID:chlabel),
  data = subset(erp_fs_nw, time_window == "N250"),
  REML = TRUE,
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
)
summary(m_confirm_nw_n250_fs)

# Effect Sizes
eta_squared(m_confirm_nw_n250_fs, partial = TRUE)

# R-squared
r2_nakagawa(m_confirm_nw_n250_fs)
```


#### EXPLORE  INTERACTION

```{r}
library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)
library(rlang)
library(purrr)

emm_options(lmer.df = "satterthwaite")

# Representative levels: mean ± 1 SD for both continuous ID dimensions
os_vals <- c(mean(erp_fs_nw$OS) - sd(erp_fs_nw$OS), mean(erp_fs_nw$OS), mean(erp_fs_nw$OS) + sd(erp_fs_nw$OS))
lp_vals <- c(mean(erp_fs_nw$LP) - sd(erp_fs_nw$LP), mean(erp_fs_nw$LP), mean(erp_fs_nw$LP) + sd(erp_fs_nw$LP))
os_labels <- c("Low OS", "Mean OS", "High OS")
lp_labels <- c("Low LP", "Mean LP", "High LP")

os_vals <- c(mean(erp_fs_nw$OS, na.rm = TRUE) - sd(erp_fs_nw$OS, na.rm = TRUE),
             mean(erp_fs_nw$OS, na.rm = TRUE),
             mean(erp_fs_nw$OS, na.rm = TRUE) + sd(erp_fs_nw$OS, na.rm = TRUE))

lp_vals <- c(mean(erp_fs_nw$LP, na.rm = TRUE) - sd(erp_fs_nw$LP, na.rm = TRUE),
             mean(erp_fs_nw$LP, na.rm = TRUE),
             mean(erp_fs_nw$LP, na.rm = TRUE) + sd(erp_fs_nw$LP, na.rm = TRUE))

os_vals
lp_vals
```

 N250 — Complexity × OS × LP × Family Size (four-way, p = .012)

Model: m_confirm_nw_n250

```{r}
emm_options(lmerTest.limit = 10000, pbkrtest.limit = 10000)

n250_fs_fourway <- map2_dfr(lp_vals, lp_labels, function(lp_fixed, lp_lab) {
  emm_obj <- emmeans(m_confirm_nw_n250_fs,
                      ~ complexity * family_size | OS,
                      at = list(OS = os_vals, LP = lp_fixed),
                      nesting = NULL)
  compact_emm_table(emm_obj, by_var = OS, condition_prefix = "OS") |>
    mutate(LP_level = lp_lab)
})

as.tibble(n250_fs_fourway) |>
  print(n = 100)
```

```{r}
# Example for the N250 FS four-way, at each LP level
n250_fs_interaction <- map2_dfr(lp_vals, lp_labels, function(lp_fixed, lp_lab) {
  emm_obj <- emmeans(m_confirm_nw_n250_fs,
                      ~ complexity * family_size | OS,
                      at = list(OS = os_vals, LP = lp_fixed),
                      nesting = NULL)
  contrast(emm_obj, interaction = "pairwise") |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    mutate(LP_level = lp_lab)
})
as.tibble(n250_fs_interaction)
```

### Model BASE FREQUENCY

```{r}
contrasts(erp_bf_nw$complexity)      <- c(-0.5, 0.5)
contrasts(erp_bf_nw$base_frequency)  <- c(-0.5, 0.5)

# N250 nonwords: specificity check for base frequency, matching the family_size
# confirmatory structure so it's a fair parallel test
m_confirm_nw_n250_bf <- lmer(
  value ~ complexity * OS + complexity * LP + complexity * base_frequency +
    OS * LP * base_frequency +
    (1 | SubjID) + (1 | SubjID:chlabel),
  data = subset(erp_bf_nw, time_window == "N250"),
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
)
summary(m_confirm_nw_n250_bf)

# Effect Sizes
eta_squared(m_confirm_nw_n250_bf, partial = TRUE)

# R-squared
r2_nakagawa(m_confirm_nw_n250_bf)

```

```{r}
m_3way <- lmer(value ~ complexity*OS + complexity*LP + complexity*base_frequency +
                        OS*LP*base_frequency + complexity:OS:LP +
                        complexity:OS:base_frequency + complexity:LP:base_frequency +
                        (1|SubjID) + (1|SubjID:chlabel),
                data = subset(erp_bf_nw, time_window == "N250"),
                REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))

m_4way <- update(m_3way, . ~ . + complexity:OS:LP:base_frequency)

anova(m_3way, m_4way)
```
